audit.why: Both layers already read Lillia / Skill / Skill / Lillia / Gwen / Gwen / Lillia, which is exactly the chart the mirror settled on after re-slotting whys[2] through whys[6] to their real stages. The two layers agree row for row, and every why-string argues its own row. No flips proposed.
audit.corrected: Chart left untouched; the full-layer why strings were the part still arguing the old generic script, so those were rewritten to match the sides they sit on.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one cooldown appears anywhere on the page, and Needlework — her ultimate — is never mentioned at all.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22s at rank 1, which is a very long window to simply wait out. Skip 'n Slash is 13s at rank 1 but partially refunds when she hits something, so it is shorter than it looks in a trade. Needlework is 120s at rank 1 and can be cast up to three times, each cast slowing — that is her actual level 6 spike and the page attributes the level 6 flip entirely to the mist.
audit.corrected: 22s, 13s and Needlework's three casts on 120s written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], the do's, whys[2], whys[4], spikes[1] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Snip Snip! is described as flat true damage that 'ignores your squishy frame'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Gwen snips in a cone up to 6 times for magic damage, and deals TRUE damage only to units in the CENTRE, applying A Thousand Cuts to them on each snip. The centre-line is dodgeable — standing off it roughly halves the trade. Describing the whole cone as true damage removes the only counterplay Lillia has to it.
audit.corrected: Centre-only true damage stated in spikes[2] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Gwen wins by landing Hallowed Mist' and 'getting clipped by Hallowed Mist' treat the mist as a skillshot.
audit.why: Riot's text: it summons mist that protects her from enemies OUTSIDE it — she can only be targeted by enemies who enter. It lands on nobody. The real interaction is that Blooming Blows, Swirlseed and Lilting Lullaby cast from outside cannot select her at all, and the counterplay is to step in or wait 22 seconds.
audit.corrected: Rewritten as a zone she stands in, with the cast-from-outside rule stated explicitly.

audit.whatIsWrong: A Thousand Cuts' healing is only gestured at as 'her sustain'.
audit.why: Riot's text: her attacks deal bonus magic damage based on target health and she heals for a portion of that damage dealt to champions. That is scaling health-based lifesteal, which is precisely why the itemization line's anti-heal note matters and why a long grind favours her.
audit.corrected: Named in spikes[2] as the thing your DoT has to out-pace.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer refers to Gwen as 'he' and 'his' in at least five strings.
audit.why: Gwen is female. Wrong pronouns on the TL;DR and the wave block are visible on first read and cost credibility immediately.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in tldr, report[0], the wave block and dontsFull[0].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Swirlseed's terrain flag is a tooltip-parsing artefact.
audit.why: Riot's text says the seed rolls until it hits a wall or target; it creates nothing.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your one true window — full Q, the burn compounding, mana to grind her down while she has to walk at you. Use it, because at 6 it flips hard. Her W, Hallowed Mist, drops a zone she's untargetable inside, so your R sleep, your Q, and your E seed all whiff if she's standing in it — you can't isolate her the way you isolate a Darius. Worse, her Q snip does true damage that ignores your squishy frame and out-trades your hops. Don't fight her on top of her mist; only commit when she's caught outside it on dash cooldown.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your one true window — full Q, the burn compounding, mana to grind her while she must walk at you. Use it, because 6 flips it hard. Hallowed Mist drops a 22-second zone she is untargetable inside, so Blooming Blows, Swirlseed and Lilting Lullaby all whiff if she stands in it. Snip Snip! deals its true damage in the CENTRE of the cone — stay off her centre-line and the trade halves. Needlework is three casts of slow on 120 seconds, so it chases you after the mist. Commit only when she is outside cover with Skip 'n Slash down.
